base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl python3 python3-pip python3-venv ca-certificates

runtime_profile.notes: Kubernetes manifest project with Python components. kubectl is used for YAML validation via dry-run. Poetry manages Python dependencies for subcomponents like redis/log-notebook.

notes: Base image debian:bookworm-slim provides git and curl by default. kubectl v1.31.0 installed for Kubernetes manifest validation. Poetry 2.4.1 installed for Python dependency management. The test framework uses kubectl apply --dry-run=client to validate YAML manifests.
